To Whom It May Concern,  

As Aditi’s direct manager at CloudNest Technologies, I’ve had the opportunity to observe her contributions to our SaaS operations over the past year. While our interactions are occasional, her work consistently aligns with our agency’s priorities of precision and adaptability.  

Aditi’s strengths lie in her ability to bridge technical rigor with collaborative problem-solving. She has taken ownership of critical QA processes, particularly in refining behavior-driven development frameworks. Her work on a customer portal rewrite, where she integrated BDD practices, reduced post-release bug density by over 40% and streamlined cross-functional communication. She also spearheaded a Python-based tool to automate data validation workflows, eliminating manual checks that previously consumed 20+ hours monthly. This script not only improved accuracy but also empowered her team to focus on edge-case scenarios.  

A standout example is her role in enhancing our test coverage for a high-stakes client project. Using Selenium and Playwright, she redesigned brittle test scripts to handle dynamic UI elements, resulting in a 35% increase in test reliability. Her approach balanced technical depth with pragmatic solutions, ensuring tests remained maintainable amid rapid feature iterations. Beyond her technical acumen, Aditi’s curiosity and willingness to iterate on imperfect solutions have elevated our team’s overall quality standards.  

Aditi’s blend of analytical focus and collaborative spirit makes her a strong candidate for any role requiring both technical precision and team alignment. I am confident she will contribute meaningfully to your organization’s goals.
